services.name: Red Star Ballooning
services.desc: Passenger flights: Gather your friends or family, and float above the landscape! Adam loves to share ballooning with people who have never had the experience before. Depending on weather, we can take up to five passengers with a combined weight of 1,000 pounds. We generally fly for about an hour, but your full ballooning experience will last about three hours. Tether: The balloon is tied to a heavy object on the ground with a rope, allowing it to fly to a predetermined height. A good way to get a large number of people in the basket, tethered flight is an option for corporate gatherings. Glow/static display: The balloon is inflated and stands on the ground.
